reviews.name: Rafiul Islam
reviews.text: Amazing rooftop experience! The ambience is absolutely stunning with all the greenery and beautiful lighting. The Hawa Special Pizza was delicious. Perfect place for a romantic dinner.

reviews.name: Fatema Akter
reviews.text: Went there for a family gathering and everyone loved it. The rooftop view is breathtaking, especially during sunset. Hyderabadi Biryani was on point. Will definitely visit again.

reviews.name: Tanvir Ahmed
reviews.text: One of the best rooftop restaurants in Mirpur area. The decoration is very creative and the food quality is great. BBQ Koral was the highlight of our evening.

reviews.name: Nusrat Jahan
reviews.text: The Hawa Blue Rainbow mocktail is a must try! Beautiful place with amazing vibes. The boat structure on the rooftop is so unique. Great for photos and celebrations.

reviews.name: Shahriar Kabir
reviews.text: Visited with friends on a weekend evening. The atmosphere is really peaceful despite being in Mirpur. Good food, reasonable prices, and the open-air seating is lovely.
